name: Koyasu Mana
source:
She is a new office worker who joined the company this spring.  She thinks she was accepted because of the main character and adores him one-sidedly.

However, her father, the executive director, is vehemently opposed to it...?

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5580]official site[/url]]
